annotations.title: See latest assessment of each student

description: Every active student with the date of the latest physical assessment (null = never assessed), days_since, weight and body fat, whether a reassessment is already booked, and the app_url of the student assessments screen. due true = past the reassessment interval (90 days by default, counted from the start of the student link when never assessed) and nothing booked, the same rule as the app reminder. only_due true answers "who is due a reassessment?", longest wait first. Next: list_assessments for one student, or schedule_class to book it. Read only.

days.description: Reassessment interval in days, 30 to 365. Default 90.

only_due.description: Only students due a reassessment. Default false.

name: get_latest_assessments
title: See latest assessment of each student
